before.content:
for name in ji-stage6-performance ji-stage6-release-smoke-relay ji-stage6-release-smoke-web ji-stage6-release-smoke-ingress; do
    docker rm -f "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  done
}
trap cleanup_containers EXIT
mkdir -p "$root/source" "$root/output" "$performance/runtime" "$performance/data"

after.content:
if ! test "$attempts" -lt 1200; then docker logs ji-stage6-performance >&2 || true; exit 1; fi
  sleep 1
done
nano_cpus=$(docker inspect ji-stage6-performance --format '{{.HostConfig.NanoCpus}}')
memory_limit=$(docker inspect ji-stage6-performance --format '{{.HostConfig.Memory}}')
memory_swap_limit=$(docker inspect ji-stage6-performance --format '{{.HostConfig.MemorySwap}}')
test "$nano_cpus" = 2000000000
test "$memory_limit" = 4294967296
test "$memory_swap_limit" = 4294967296
printf '{"metric":"capacity","nanoCpus":%s,"memoryBytes":%s,"memoryAndSwapBytes":%s}\n' \
  "$nano_cpus" "$memory_limit" "$memory_swap_limit" >> "$root/output/performance-result.ndjson"
find_cgroup() {
  id=$(docker inspect "$1" --format '{{.Id}}')
  path=$(find /sys/fs/cgroup -type d -name "$id" -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true)
